purpose: Translate the installed D01-D12 collaborative strategy into one bounded product-construction cycle without redefining deficiencies or promoting provisional Gratitude morphology to planetary authority.

recipe.action: Replace perceptible second-box continuation with a noninteractive near-middle-far visual envelope. Ocean-facing continuation remains open water; inland and lateral continuation inherit local edge slope and terrain frequency before progressively losing detail into atmospheric depth.

Convert first-glance environmental identity from arid/desert to warm subtropical coastal using local causal fields: elevation, slope, drainage tendency, freshwater proximity, shelter/exposure and coastal influence. Preserve justified rock/soil exposure and create a living inland-to-beach-to-nearshore ecological gradient.

Keep environmental and continuation logic morphology-tolerant by deriving primary behavior from reusable local fields rather than distance to the current outer silhouette. Improve only regional-scale directional asymmetry and locally believable headland/bay/drainage/relief relationships that can survive later macro remapping.

Emit a regional positional-standard evidence description from the constructed Gratitude candidate: coastline orientation, relief orientation, drainage tendency, climate/biome family and water relationship. This is evidence for later Audralia reconciliation, not an Audralia mutation in this cycle.

Materialize the exact product candidate and perform exact-candidate qualification for first-glance place legibility, immersion, traversal continuity, phone/tablet/desktop behavior, accessibility and performance. Underlying continuation mechanics must not dominate the visual read.

terminalLaw: CONSTRUCTION MAY NOT CLAIM SUCCESS BY PARTIAL DEFICIENCY IMPROVEMENT. THE EXACT CANDIDATE MUST PRESERVE ALL PROTECTED STRENGTHS AND SATISFY THE ADMITTED ACCEPTANCE CONDITIONS OR RETURN REPAIR_REQUIRED.
